name: Sydney Kamlager-Dove

items.text: At an April 1, 2025 House subcommittee hearing, Kamlager-Dove said Republicans were "elevating a serial sexual harasser" as their witness. The witness was journalist Matt Taibbi, and she reposted the remarks online. He sued for defamation. In June 2026 a federal judge dismissed the suit, ruling her statements were part of her job as a member of Congress. The ruling did not decide whether the claim was true.
items.why: A court dismissed the libel suit on scope-of-office grounds without ruling on truth or falsity, so there is no finding of lying about her record or of abuse of office under criteria 5 or 6.

for_review: I found no public response from Kamlager-Dove to the suit or the dismissal. Reporting from 2025 said she had not responded. I read the Volokh/Reason excerpt of the June 2026 D.N.J. opinion (Judge Padin) but not the full opinion, which is on CourtListener. I did not open the two articles she entered into the hearing record (one is a Chicago Reader piece), so I can't say how well they support her claim. Taibbi's complaint says no woman has accused him of harassment. That is his claim, not a finding. The $10 million figure and the April 3, 2025 filing date appear in search snippets from Daily Caller and others, but I did not open those pages, so I left them out of the text. The one search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing relevant to this item. I also did not check whether Taibbi has appealed.
